observation: Pruning is now a post-processing chain in the workflow, not a filter in the relation SQL. pharos_publish emits every candidate record with an empty mark list and a keep verdict; pharos_annotate contributes one step per (rule, component) that appends the rule's mark where its predicate holds; pharos_project keeps the records whose verdict is keep and drops the annotation columns; file.annotated writes the marked view, file.graph writes the projection, and pharos_reconcile fails the build unless annotated minus pruned equals shipped, per kind. The interaction threshold and the ligand policy are both rule modules: string_below_700 and single_target_ligand, the latter reading target_count that the relations now carry instead of HAVING count >= 2.
subject: F-131
title: Pruning is a post-processing chain, not a relation filter
